messages:
anika: Heads up — product is planning a staged rollout of firefly-22b next week (EU + APAC first). We need a quick capacity hit estimate and any region-specific gotchas.

matt: Thanks, can you share expected qps and average tokens per request?

anika: Initial target traffic: 250 qps global, but EU + APAC first slice = 100 qps combined. Median prompt ~120 tokens, reply ~280 tokens -> ~400 tokens total per call.

jie: Quick calc: 100 qps * 400 tokens = 40k tokens/sec for launch slice. For GPU hours, depends on current perf baseline.

sam: From perf lab, firefly-22b @ fp16 on A100s gives ~55 tokens/sec per GPU (single-stream typical). With batching we see 160-220 tokens/sec steady depending on seq len.

matt: If we assume conservative 140 tokens/sec per GPU (accounting for variability), 40k tokens/sec needs ~286 GPUs for EU+APAC slice. Add safety margin and prewarm pool -> round to 340.

anika: Oof that's high. Can we get better with 8-bit quant or sharded variants?

jie: Quantization to int8 gets ~1.6x throughput in some tests. If we assume 1.5x improvement that's 210 tokens/sec per GPU -> 190 GPUs. With 20% headroom -> 230.

sam: Also worth noting prefix caching / short prompt reuse can reduce effective tokens/sec by up to 10-15% depending on app. Product says some chat flows will reuse context, but we shouldn't count on full savings.

matt: Region constraints: EU data residency requires Private deployment for some customers. If they use Private, capacity is customer-managed but we'll need to advise on reserved GPU sizing. For Hosted EU pool, our current A100 spare headroom is ~120 GPUs in eu-west-1.

anika: So hosted EU shortfall is ~110 GPUs (if they don't quantize). Ops: can you confirm available APAC spare?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Current spare capacity snapshots: eu-west-1 A100 spare = 118, ap-southeast-1 A100 spare = 54, us-west-2 A100 spare = 98.

jie: Combined EU+APAC spare = 172. If we go with quantized plan (230 GPUs total) we can fit if we shift some load to us-west burst region and enable routing. But that increases cross-region egress and latency.

sam: Cost note: running 230 A100s continuously for 24h ~ 230 * 24 * $3.10 (example GPU hr) = ~$17k/day -> ~$510k/month. If we use shared hosted fleet with autoscaling and not full 24/7 baseline, bill lower. Dedicated reserved pricing and commitments will cut unit cost ~30-40%.

matt: Proposal: run a 72-hour soak in EU+APAC with a mixed config: 60% quantized instances + 40% fp16; prewarm 20% as hot pool; enable caching and aggressive batching for non-interactive routes. That should hit functional capacity while limiting full-cost baseline.

anika: Behavioral concerns: latency SLO target is 250ms p95. Quantized variant p95 in lab was 180-220ms for median seq, but tail can spike >400ms under noisy multi-tenant loads. We need autoscale thresholds and fallback to smaller cheaper model (firefly-7b) for degraded tail.

jie: Suggested autoscale policy: scale-up when 95th-token-latency > 200ms for 60s OR queued-requests > 30; scale-down after 10m stable. Canary routing: 10% traffic to quantized variant day1; ramp 25% day2; full by day4.

sam: Networking: cross-region fallback will add 40-80ms RTT. That may breach p95 for some SLAs. Also monitor egress costs — estimate extra egress $0.02/token*? (product to confirm).

anika: Action items:
- matt: produce concise GPU count table for three scenarios (fp16 baseline, int8 mixed, aggressive caching) by EOD.
- jie: add autoscale + rollback policy to the launch runbook.
- sam: run a 4-hour load test with quantized build on eu-west-1 using 2 synthetic clients to measure tail.
- ops-bot: flag regions with insufficient spare capacity and list available cloud procurement options.

matt: Will do. Early note: if product insists on EU-only hosted for early customers, we should recommend a short-term Dedicated pool contract to cover peak for week 1.

anika: Thanks team. If anyone spots an obvious miscalc, shout now. Otherwise we'll sync tomorrow 10am to finalize numbers. :calendar: :thumbsup:
